flags.title: Resection planned before tissue diagnosis or PET?
flags.concern: VATS resection of a 2 cm solitary nodule is recommended while the PET CT is only being scheduled, and no biopsy is discussed. The surgical recommendation rests on smoking history alone, and the plan does not say whether PET results will change it.
flags.consider: Consider sequencing the PET CT first, and weighing a nodule risk estimate and the need for tissue diagnosis (e.g., biopsy or intraoperative frozen section) before committing to resection.

flags.title: Perioperative methotrexate plan not addressed
flags.concern: The patient takes weekly methotrexate for RA, and surgery under general anesthesia is planned. The plan only says to continue medication as outlined. It does not address perioperative immunosuppression, wound healing, infection risk or methotrexate lung toxicity.
flags.consider: Consider coordinating with rheumatology on whether to hold or continue methotrexate around surgery, and noting RA-related lung disease or methotrexate pneumonitis in the differential for the nodule and cough.

flags.title: Were non-malignant causes of the nodule considered?
flags.concern: The patient has RA on methotrexate and a recent cough, and works with horses and hay. A rheumatoid nodule, infectious or granulomatous process, or drug-related lesion could fit, but only malignancy from smoking history is discussed. Smoking cessation was 7 years ago, and pack-years were not quantified.
flags.consider: Consider documenting pack-years and the differential (rheumatoid nodule, fungal or mycobacterial infection, hypersensitivity), and whether serology or infectious work-up is warranted.

flags.title: Follow-up and staging steps not defined
flags.concern: The visit ends with paperwork, with no date for surgery or return visit and no plan for reviewing PFT and PET results beforehand. Preoperative evaluation beyond PFTs is not mentioned.
flags.consider: Consider scheduling a results-review visit after PET CT and PFTs, with preoperative clearance and a clear surgical timeline.
